modes.cue_notes: Hinge from the hips with a soft bend in the knees, folding the torso over the legs. Let the head hang heavy and the neck release. Hands may rest on the floor, blocks, or shins.

breathing_cues.entering: Exhale as you hinge at the hips and fold forward over the legs.
breathing_cues.holding: Inhale to lengthen the spine slightly, exhale to soften deeper into the fold.
breathing_cues.exiting: Inhale as you bend the knees and roll up slowly through the spine, stacking one vertebra at a time.

notes: Calming forward fold; bend knees generously if hamstrings are tight to protect the low back.
